name: Bot Battle Merc
comment: A regular Bot Battle Merc (not the Space Command HQ dungeon's mech, which has more: minigun levels, missile volleys by health, drones; the user, 2026-10-30): the mech's stomp up close (361429: 4 m, knockaway, particle_bot_battle_merc_stomp) and a missile with its red X marker (361424). Which of the boss mech's spells the regular ones had is the user's memory (missiles) and a guess (the stomp). It was the generic Shot before, which played a jumping animation the mech's look lacks.
